messages.content: I’ll use RegDn to build stored energy, keep up-reserve awards within the meter’s available headroom, and save energy for the higher-priced evening hours. I’ll reassess as notices and actual prices arrive.

The watch-0 commit was rejected because one AS array had the wrong length. The day-ahead book therefore remained at zero battery output and zero AS awards, and AS awards are now locked. I’ll continue with energy-only dispatch and manage the remaining day.
The battery is at 200 MWh. The current book discharges 100 MW in each of hours 20 and 21, then recharges to the 100 MWh end-of-day target. I’ll keep monitoring for any intervening watch or notice.
